content.text:
Implemented the scaffold CLI fix.

Changed [packages/scaffold/src/cli.ts](packages/scaffold/src/cli.ts) so:

- npm installs run through `process.env.npm_execpath` when the CLI was launched by npm/npx, avoiding `spawnSync npm ENOENT` when the `npm` binary itself is not on `PATH`.
- The CLI only changes into the generated app directory after a successful automatic install.
- If install fails or is skipped, the recovery next steps now keep the real target directory, so the user sees `cd test1` instead of `cd .`.

Added regression coverage in [packages/scaffold/tests/cli.test.ts](packages/scaffold/tests/cli.test.ts), plus a patch changeset in [.changeset/smart-pants-smile.md](.changeset/smart-pants-smile.md) for `@pantoken/scaffold` and `create-pantoken-app`.

Validation run:

- `vp test packages/scaffold/tests/cli.test.ts` passed: 53 tests
- `vp test packages/create-pantoken-app/tests/index.test.ts` passed: 8 tests
- `vp check packages/scaffold/src/cli.ts packages/scaffold/tests/cli.test.ts packages/create-pantoken-app/tests/index.test.ts` passed
- `vp run release:status` recognized the patch changeset

I also ran the required final `vp test --coverage`; it failed in an unrelated existing test: [renderers/pendo/tests/build.test.ts](renderers/pendo/tests/build.test.ts#L23), where generated `global.css` does not start with the exact package version. The scaffold/create-app tests stayed green.
